author: Abu Muhammad Abd Allah ibn Abi Zayd al-Qayrawani (d. 386 AH)

licence.evidence: A web search index reports the OpenITI Primary Version release on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.10021513) as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, matching the licence recorded for al-Akhdari. The Zenodo record could not be opened from the build environment (egress blocked), and the OpenITI 0400AH repository contains no licence file. Confirm on the Zenodo record before publication.

files.notes: Marked PRIMARY_VERSION and CLEANED_VERSION in OpenITI (paratext removed in 2023). Header: Dar al-Fikr, Beirut; editor, year and ISBN not recorded. Unvowelled. Contains the author's introduction and all 45 chapters, with page markers V01P001 to V01P170.
Shamela 11373, 'Matn al-Risala', Dar al-Fikr, same 170-page numbering. Unvowelled. Omits the author's introduction. Used only to cross-check the 45 chapter headings; no wording is taken from it.

notUsed.reason: Only the creed introduction ('Aqidat al-Salaf'), ed. Bakr Abu Zayd, Dar al-Asima; not the whole work.
Opens with the preface of Salih Abd al-Sami' al-Abi al-Azhari, a later compiler; no edition recorded and the death year given as 389. Not a clean witness of the matn.

vowelling: None. All three full OpenITI versions have no vowel marks (0 marks in about 25,000 words). The library does not add tashkil to this text.
printedEditionComparison: Not done. No printed edition has been chosen or inspected; see docs/RISALA.md.
